skin_expression_endpoint: Mean source-normalized SOX9 over all original Fib cells, zeros included
skin_patient_aggregation: Equal library weighting within recorded patient; 5 normal and 10 scar units
figure1_test: two-sided Welch t test; BH across the five organ tests
figure2_identity: C12 highest mean SOX9; 185 cells, 61 SOX9+; original Myo_Fib=183; KRT14-high purity unresolved
spatial_gate: source sub_labels starts Fib_; SOX9 >0 AND COL1A1 >0; rat Sox9 >0 AND Col1a1 >0
spatial_statistics: Descriptive sections; no independent animal/donor test, P/FDR NE
spatial_semantics: Human scar/scarless side anchors; rat wound-centre/flank is NOT validated scar-inside/outside
culture_pseudobulk: log2(sum raw gene counts / sum full-library-state UMIs * 1e6 + 1)
culture_correlation: Spearman across eight library pseudobulks per state; BH separately over five genes within each state
culture_state_difference: Two-sided exact Wilcoxon paired across libraries; BH over six genes
source_marker_adjustment: Source Seurat marker p_val_adj = Bonferroni across 24884 genes; not BH
